Package io.github.jinghui70.rainbow.dbaccess.fieldmapper

Class BlobObjectFieldMapper<T>

java.lang.Object
io.github.jinghui70.rainbow.dbaccess.fieldmapper.FieldMapper<T>
io.github.jinghui70.rainbow.dbaccess.fieldmapper.BlobFieldMapper<T>
io.github.jinghui70.rainbow.dbaccess.fieldmapper.BlobObjectFieldMapper<T>
Type Parameters:
T - 目标 Java 类型
public class BlobObjectFieldMapper<T> extends BlobFieldMapper<T>
BLOB JSON 对象字段映射器。

将 Java 对象序列化为 JSON 字符串后以 UTF-8 编码存储为 BLOB， 读取时从 BLOB 解码为 JSON 字符串再反序列化为 Java 对象。
